Design: Fixed proof factor ablation and contract-conditioned single-deal role comparison
Rules: Unconfigured default; explicit presets receive functional tests only

Corpus.lowerRisk: Lowest risk 8 of remaining 248 indices; tie by index
Corpus.Risk: Initial declarer ten cards only: sum(joker?25:max(0,rank-6)/(1+count lower same suit)); no outcomes or future actions used
Corpus.NormalContracts: 7 tricks, rotating S/C/D/H; unfiltered seeds only

Bidding: Forced legal prerequisite 7S/8S then target for Misere/Open; normal opener Pass then declarer target. Strategy bidding not evaluated, does not consume RNG
Discard: All32 algorithm and same seat RNG seeds in every arm; assert exact same discard set
Outcome: Contract Made and score delta; one completed deal, not full-match win rate; engine Truncated is expected at this one-round cap
Primary: Misere and Open separate; declarer make rate vs baseline; defender bust rate vs baseline
Inference: Pair on same seed; separate cohorts and contract types; do not treat three arms as independent samples; no parameter retuning or default promotion
